an alternative transaction that would replace their previously announced merger agreement.
Neighborhood would contribute its ~38.8% direct and indirect stake in tZERO, Medici-related fund assets, and its GrainChain investment to Fathom.
The contributed digital assets would be valued at no less than $130M.
In exchange, NXH would receive newly issued Fathom shares and is expected to retain a controlling interest in Fathom after the transaction.
The proposed structure would allow Fathom to pursue additional acquisitions while expanding its brokerage and title operations.
Fathom and NXH also plan to explore blockchain/tokenization applications in real estate, including potential commercial real estate and single-family rental assets.
The previously announced deal, under which Fathom shareholders would have received 0.2236 NXH shares per Fathom share, is expected to be terminated.

title: Fathom, Neighborhood explore alternative $130M+ asset transaction
